overview: In its inaugural meeting, the committee established operational procedures, selected officers, and determined a monthly meeting schedule. Members adopted a code of conduct and set guidelines for public participation during the charter review process.

items.title: Introductions
items.summary: Committee members and city staff introduced themselves, sharing their neighborhoods and specific interests in reviewing the city charter.

items.title: Legal and Administrative Overview
items.summary: The chairs reviewed the committee's obligations under Open Meeting, Public Records, and Conflict of Interest laws and introduced the advisory role of the Collins Center for Public Management.

items.title: Code of Conduct
items.summary: The committee adopted a code of conduct emphasizing respect, active listening, and preparedness for all members.

items.title: Meeting Schedule and Logistics
items.summary: The committee agreed to meet monthly at 6:30 p.m., alternating between the first Thursday and fourth Wednesday of each month.

items.title: Selection of Secretary and Administrators
items.summary: Matt Leming was selected as secretary, and John Moreshi and Mike Mastrobuoni volunteered to serve as Zoom administrators.

items.title: Public Participation Procedures
items.summary: The committee decided to hold public comment periods at the end of meetings, limiting individual speakers to three minutes and a maximum of two speaking turns.

items.title: Digital Collaboration and Broadcasts
items.summary: Members discussed using digital collaboration tools for document sharing and confirmed that future meetings would be broadcast by Medford Community Media.
